orders.customer_id: references users.user_id where usertype=1 (the customer who placed the order)
orders.vendor_id: references users.user_id where usertype=2 (the vendor who fulfilled the order)
orders.amount: order total (demo data — no currency implied)
orders.payment_method: demo-only label (cash/card/wallet/hybrid_card_wallet/hybrid_wallet_cash) added for readability while seeding; may not exist in production data — do not rely on it, use onlinepaymentmethod + isWallet instead
orders.onlinepaymentmethod: payment method code: 1 = cash, 2 = card. For wallet-only payments this defaults to 1. For hybrid payments, the non-wallet component decides the code (card+wallet -> 2, wallet+cash -> 1)
orders.isWallet: true if a wallet was used as part of the payment (alone or combined with card/cash), false otherwise
orders.payby: breakdown of how much of `amount` was paid via each method, e.g. {"cash": 100} or {"wallet": 40, "card": 60}; values always sum to `amount`
orders.status: order status: completed, pending, or refunded (demo data)

users.usertype: discriminator: 1 = customer, 2 = vendor. Customers and vendors share this single collection -- ANY query about 'customers' or 'vendors' MUST filter on usertype (1 or 2 respectively) in addition to any other criteria, or it will silently mix both kinds of user together
users.status: account status: active, inactive, or suspended (demo data). 'active customers'/'active vendors' means status == 'active' AND usertype matches
users.city: demo-only label for the user's city (Karachi/Lahore/Islamabad); coarse alternative to `location` for non-geo filtering
users.location: GeoJSON Point {type: 'Point', coordinates: [lng, lat]} -- has a 2dsphere index, use with $near/$geoWithin for 'nearby' queries. coordinates are [longitude, latitude], NOT [lat, lng]
users.last_active_at: timestamp of the user's last activity (UTC) -- use this for 'active in the last N days' questions, not `status`
users.loyalty_tier: customer-only field (usertype=1): bronze/silver/gold; absent on vendor documents
users.business_name: vendor-only field (usertype=2); absent on customer documents
users.category: vendor-only field (usertype=2): restaurant/grocery/pharmacy/electronics/clothing; absent on customer documents
users.rating: vendor-only field (usertype=2): 3.0-5.0; absent on customer documents
